title: Measuring PPFD on Algal Shaker
author: Jakub Nedbal
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdyxi7xn

steps.title: Prepare Shaker and Environment
steps.instruction: Prepare the algal shaker and the measurement environment to ensure accuracy.

substeps.instruction: Switch off the algal shaker.
Clear all culture flasks from the algal shaker and move it onto a bench.
Work in a dark room with all lights turned off; keep them off throughout the measurements.

steps.title: Configure Light Meter for Air
steps.instruction: Connect the Walz probe to the Li-COR Light Meter and set the calibration for air measurement.

substeps.instruction: Set the Li-COR Light Meter calibration to -274.3 (or the specific value provided in the calibration data for the utilized probe).

steps.title: Measure PPFD in Air
steps.instruction: Measure the PPFD at various points on the shaker platform across all LED settings.

substeps.instruction: Place the probe vertically upright on a random spot on top of the illuminated shaker platform.
Keep your hand as far away from the illuminator as possible to minimize light scattering from the hand and sleeve.
Record the value.
Repeat this process in twelve different random locations (determine locations with eyes closed or by looking away to avoid bias).
Repeat the entire 12-point measurement process for all eight LED current settings.

steps.title: Configure Light Meter for Water
steps.instruction: Adjust the Li-COR Light Meter calibration for water measurement.

substeps.instruction: Set the Li-COR Light Meter calibration to -471.9 (or the specific value provided in the calibration data for the utilized probe).

steps.title: Measure PPFD in Water
steps.instruction: Measure the PPFD inside a flask containing deionized water across all LED settings.

substeps.instruction: Place a 100 ml Erlenmeyer flask containing deionized water onto the illuminated shaker platform.
Place the probe into the flask, keeping it vertical.
Fix the flask mouth with cotton wool to replicate the plug normally used in cultures.
Record the value.
Move the flask to another random spot and repeat the measurement in twelve different places (determine locations with eyes closed or by looking away to avoid bias).
Repeat the entire 12-point measurement process for all eight LED current settings.

steps.title: Analyze Data using MATLAB
steps.instruction: Process the recorded PPFD measurements using the specified MATLAB code.

substeps.instruction: Download the PPFD analysis code from GitHub: github.com/jnedbal/PPFD.

Download the UnivarScatter function from Mathworks File Exchange (https://uk.mathworks.com/matlabcentral/fileexchange/54243-univarscatter) and place it in the same folder as PPFD.m or add it to the MATLAB path.
Update the PPFD.xlsx file with the actual measurement values obtained from the shaker.
Run PPFD in MATLAB to generate the graphs.
